text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(This... scenery... It reminds me of when 
I ran with my own flesh and blood...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Her speed is not inferior. However, it 
isn't overwhelmingly superior either...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(I've been trying my best too. I've worked 
so hard, and yet... Ah...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: (Still... not quite there, huh...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... I did everything I could. 
However...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
This is my current limit... The cutting 
edge... of robotics...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
However, I can still push forward from 
here. I'll keep making adjustments.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's difficult, I now know that a 
path exists.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
There is no reason for me to cry. ST-2 
cannot—shed tears.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It does not possess that level of 
functionality. However...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: I wonder how the mother body is doing.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry. If only I could have been more 
helpful...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true. My Trainer did 
everything they could for me."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: And then... everyone else, too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good work, Doctor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You gave it your best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I've seen your true resolve.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Go forth. Continue onward, toward the Deus 
Ex Machina.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"We just obtained another piece of useful 
data. That's all there is to it. Right?"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Ah, the wind at Tokyo Racecourse is—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It washes everything away... It feels so 
good.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please watch my running one last 
time. When we show it off to everyone.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I want you... I want all of you to witness 
this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, ST-2 completed the final Upgrade 
Exam.
